commit_binding: The incoming control COMMIT identifies the immutable evidence commit containing this request. REVIEWED_COMMIT must equal that exact control COMMIT. REVIEWED_IMPLEMENTATION_COMMIT must separately equal implementation_commit. Fetch both exact commits and compare the PR/branch head at review start; never silently substitute another commit.
mission: Substantive independent GitHub-only review of the accepted B2 Fresh 0.9.8 closure, then one bounded Codex follow-up and Round 5 independent review.
review_questions: Inspect the actual exact-commit source and tests; identify any real defect in authentication, startup credential handoff, persistence, replay/checkpoint, source/build readiness or scope isolation.
Review append-only at-least-once attempts, late canonical results/duplicates, original identity preservation and no auto-send on restart/reload.
Review semantic full-wire/role-heading/paired-turn completion matching, exact native-tab/URL binding and prohibition on crossing another user or unknown turn.
Review explicit observe_attempt separation from composer/send/retry and bounded authenticated maintenance/reconnect. Is any authority or completion gate weaker than documented?
Distinguish accepted runtime metrics, offline checks and unproven deployment/generalized behavior. Do not infer a ten-turn, failure-campaign or production pass.

Return a finite bounded NEXT_CODEX_INSTRUCTION. For CHANGES_REQUIRED cite exact source evidence and smallest correction. For PASS_CONTINUE specify a concrete additional offline verification/evidence action; do not manufacture a source change.

reply_rules.REVIEWED_COMMIT: Exact incoming COMMIT, not inferred latest HEAD
reply_rules.FINDINGS: Array; cite file/line or function, severity, defect and evidence. Empty is allowed only after substantive review.
reply_rules.NEXT_CODEX_INSTRUCTION: A finite object with scope_paths, steps, required_checks, expected_result. Stay within this mission.
reply_rules.GITHUB_RESOURCES_READ: Array of actual reads only. Each file read: path, ref_commit, github_url, read_method and a short exact source_excerpt obtained from that read. Include required evidence and source paths. Do not claim a read from the request summary. Record failure truthfully.
reply_rules.REVIEW_SUMMARY: Substantive code-based reasoning, not a transport echo or predetermined PASS.

frozen_boundaries: GitHub is the only evidence plane
No Work/IAB/old C2C MCP/Cloudflare/OpenAI API/new external service
No family-fund or other product change
No Host/Origin/control-token weakening or stored ephemeral token
